name: NetwareHandler
title: NetwareHandler - Global
summary: The NetwareHandler script include implements an SNMP handler for Netware OS.
overview:
This handler is designed to be invoked by Classify.java as an interim step toward completely moving the SNMP sensors into JavaScript.

Use this script include for SNMP classification.

members.name: classifyAndIdentify
members.summary: Classifies and identifies the SNMP device.
